entities.summary: Japanese, a notable figure in the history of Malaysia, associated with Japanese Occupation and Malayan Emergency (1942–1945). Preceded by Japanese Occupation and Resistance and Japanese forces conquer Malaya and capture Singapore. Their legacy influenced Malayan Union Controversy and Merdeka and Malaya achieves independence (Merdeka) under Tunku Abdul Rahman.
